name: bring up
cmd: ip link set eth0 up && ip addr add 192.168.86.100/24 dev eth0 && ip route add default via 192.168.86.1 && printf '192.0.2.1 api.anthropic.com\n' >> /etc/hosts && echo up

name: timed probe x3
cmd: for i in 1 2 3; do time temur doctor 2>&1 | grep -c 'PASS: reachable'; done 2>&1 | grep -E 'real|^[0-9]'
